document.title: Group attention: one judgment call per group
document.summary: Group `lookFor` becomes one optional typed `attention` (`contract`, `tradeoff`, `product`, `risk`) through the schema, the CLI, the API, the UI, the skill, and the eval. Document `lookFor` stays for source verdicts, and old documents with group `lookFor` still load.
document.why: [#164](source:s1) asks each group to hold at most one typed attention, the one call only the maintainer can make, instead of group `lookFor` findings with text tags only the UI parsed.

sources.title: Group attention: one judgment call per group
sources.gist: Replace group lookFor with one typed attention per group; keep document lookFor for source verdicts; legacy parse for old documents.

sources.label: PR #168
sources.gist: Replaces group lookFor with one typed attention per group across schema, CLI, UI, skill, and eval, and reports the full graded eval.

lookFor: [#164](source:s1) asks the Overview triage lanes from #71 to list group attentions. Main has no lanes: commit `58c1302` removed group claims from Overview. The Overview group rows show the Look closely mark instead.

groups.title: Attention in the schema
groups.why: [#164](source:s1) asks for one typed `attention` per group and a legacy parse for old group `lookFor`.
groups.summary: `review.ts` adds `attentionSchema` with a `kind` from `ATTENTION_KINDS`, and the input schema turns an old group `lookFor` into `legacyLookFor` that `legacyLookForErrors` names.

attention.note: A `review.json` with group `lookFor` still parses, so `serve` and `export` show it with a warning. `validate` now exits 1 on it until each group's `lookFor` becomes `attention` or goes. Decide whether old documents need nothing more than that message.

groups.title: Legacy lookFor in validate, refresh, and write
groups.why: [#164](source:s1) asks `validate` to fail group `lookFor` and `refresh` to name the groups that still need it converted.
groups.summary: `legacyLookForErrors` feeds `cmdValidate` and `reviewProblems`, `legacyLookForLine` ends the refresh report, and `storedDocument` writes the old field back so the skill can still read it.

attention.note: `storedDocument` puts legacy `lookFor` back on each group, in the file and in `api/review.json`, so a refresh from a hosted export can still convert it. The cost is that `StoredReviewDocument`, the UI's document type, carries an optional group `lookFor` the UI never renders.

groups.title: Attention in the API payloads
groups.why: [#164](source:s1) asks agent-md for an `Attention:` block and What changed for an attention that was added, removed, or rewritten.
groups.summary: `ApiAttentionChange` lets `changesPayload` report an attention as added, removed, or rewritten, and `attentionBlock` writes it into each group's agent markdown.

groups.title: Look closely mark and attention alert
groups.why: [#164](source:s1) asks for a Look closely badge in the group nav and an alert between the summary and the hunks.
groups.summary: `Attention.tsx` gives `GroupBrief` its alert and `Sidebar` and `Overview` their Look closely mark, while `claims.ts` replaces the tag parser in `look-for.ts` and routes a source click to a document `lookFor` bullet or a group attention.

attention.note: The Overview group rows also show Look closely, beside the sidebar badge the issue asks for, because main has no triage lanes to list attentions in. Decide whether the mark belongs in both places.

groups.title: Skill: Attention plus document lookFor
groups.why: [#164](source:s1) gives the skill rule for attention and keeps the verdict rule for document `lookFor`.
groups.summary: The `lookFor` section of `SKILL.md` splits into Attention and a document-only `lookFor` that also names the instruction bullet from #166, and the steps, Refresh step 4, and `example.md` follow; the `.agents/skills` copies are identical synced output.

attention.note: Behavior changes that ask for no decision now go in the group `summary`, and bugs, missing tests, nits, and refactor ideas go nowhere. A finding that past runs wrote as a group `lookFor` bullet can now be absent from the review. Decide whether that loss is the intended scope.

groups.title: Eval grades attention notes
groups.why: [#164](source:s1) asks all 11 `expected.md` files to give each Must claim a home and to name findings, nits, and refactor ideas under Must not.
groups.summary: `claimBullets` in `graders.ts` hands the grader each document `lookFor` bullet and each attention note to check against head, and every `expected.md` gains a case-specific Must not and a note on where its Must claims live.

attention.note: The grader's bullets count now includes attention notes, and each case has one more Must not. Totals from runs before this change are not directly comparable, in exchange for grading every claim the review states as fact.

groups.title: Glossary and contributor docs
groups.why: [#164](source:s1) asks the glossary to add Attention and narrow Look for to the document level.
groups.summary: `docs/glossary.md` defines Attention and narrows Look for to source verdicts, and `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` name attention where they list the fields the skill fills.

groups.title: Generated JSON Schema
groups.why: `pnpm generate:schema` writes the JSON Schema from `review.ts`, and `pnpm sync:skill` copies it into the skill.
groups.summary: The three `review.schema.json` files are the same generated output: group `lookFor` becomes `attention` and the document `lookFor` description names source verdicts, so the reader can skip them.

commits.subject: Refresh names legacy lookFor groups even with nothing to refresh; What changed shows a new group's attention; source verdicts keep their fetch reason
commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: Name attention in the review hint; an empty legacy lookFor needs no conversion
commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: Skill, glossary, and eval: attention plus document lookFor
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The skill rewrites its lookFor section into Attention (one typed judgment call per group) and document lookFor (source verdicts, no tag prefixes). Refresh step 4 drops or re-checks an attention on gone or changed hunks and converts legacy group lookFor. The example, glossary, review criteria, and all 11 expected.md files follow: each case gains a Must-not for findings, nits, and refactor ideas written as attention, and notes where its group-level Must claims live.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Group attention replaces group lookFor
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Each group gets at most one typed attention (contract, tradeoff, product, risk) with a note. Document lookFor stays for source verdicts. Old documents with group lookFor still load; validate, serve, and refresh name the groups to convert. The UI shows a Look closely mark in the group lists, an alert in the group brief, and attention changes on What changed. agent-md writes an Attention block. The eval grader checks attention notes against head.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
